title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: The third option's M symbol is oversized relative to the name, rather than a small supporting symbol.
The third symbol has irregular overlapping green and black shading, making it less clean and simple than the other options.

judge.summary: Three distinct, readable logo options meet most requirements, though the third uses an oversized, less cleanly rendered symbol.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown, not a collage.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: The full name and ampersand are clearly legible in all three images.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: All three include a symbol in the requested positions, but the third option's M is large and visually dominant rather than small.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: The options use a bicycle above the name, a botanical sprig beside stacked text, and an M-shaped mark above the name.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: All three have green symbols and black lettering on plain white backgrounds, with no labels or mockup scenes.
